SG · Singapore open · 16 facts
TopicCategoryValueStatusSourceQuestionNotes
Ease (research rating)allEasyEstimate or ratingresearch rating
research-logistics.md §6.1
Duty-free limitallNo duty on our categories: SG duty applies only to liquor, tobacco, motor vehicles and petroleumVerified (primary source)Singapore Customs
research/logistics/05-regulations-sea.md §1
Import tax-free limitallImport GST relief for air/post consignments with CIF up to S$400; under OVR the GST is charged at sale insteadVerified (primary source)Singapore Customs, OVR page
research/logistics/05-regulations-sea.md §1
How limits are testedallOVR: S$400 tested per item on the sales value excluding separately charged shipping, insurance, GST and duty (CIF election possible). GST itself is charged on the price including shippingVerified (primary source)IRAS e-Tax Guide OVR, 5th ed., 2026-01-30, §5.4, §16
research/logistics/05-regulations-sea.md §1
Import VAT/GST rateall9% GSTVerified (primary source)IRAS
research/logistics/05-regulations-sea.md §1
Duty rate (indicative)all0%Verified (primary source)Singapore Customs
research/logistics/05-regulations-sea.md §1
Preference for origin goodsall · from VNNot needed: duty is already 0%Does not applysource
research/logistics/05-regulations-sea.md §0
Seller collection schemeallOVR for low-value goods up to S$400 per item: 9% GST at sale, pay-only regime, quarterly returns due 1 month after the periodVerified (primary source)IRAS e-Tax Guide OVR, 5th ed.
research/logistics/05-regulations-sea.md §1
When we must registerallGlobal turnover above S$1m AND B2C low-value goods plus remote services to SG above S$100k in 12 monthsVerified (primary source)IRAS e-Tax Guide OVR, 5th ed.
research/logistics/05-regulations-sea.md §1
q14An SG entity would register as a normal GST business instead (different test)
Our tax ID on the shipmentallOur GST number and a GST-paid flag per item in the courier declaration (ACCESS for air express, TradeNet permit, or CN22/CN23 for post); otherwise Customs charges GST againVerified (primary source)IRAS e-Tax Guide OVR §8.3-8.4
research/logistics/05-regulations-sea.md §1
Buyer data requiredallNone beyond name, address, phoneVerified (primary source)IRAS e-Tax Guide OVR
research/logistics/05-regulations-sea.md §1
Product safety and chemical rulesallCGSR post-market general safety; apparel and costume jewellery named; ASTM F2999 listed for jewellery; test reports on requestSecondary sourcesource
research-product-compliance.md §4.1
Seller dutiesallAll-in price (no drip pricing); true trade descriptionsSecondary sourcesource
research-product-compliance.md §4.1
Change-of-mind withdrawalallNone for online sales; post the returns policy before purchaseSecondary sourcesource
research-product-compliance.md §5
Refund must include duties?allNot for disclosed change-of-mind returns; yes for defective goodsSecondary sourcesource
research-product-compliance.md §5
Tax or duty back on returnsallRefund the GST to the buyer, issue a credit note, adjust the next OVR returnVerified (primary source)IRAS e-Tax Guide OVR §14.8

KR · South Korea open · 14 facts
TopicCategoryValueStatusSourceQuestionNotes
Ease (research rating)allMedium-easyEstimate or ratingresearch rating
research/logistics/06-regulations-apac.md §5
Duty-free limitallTotal customs value up to US$150 including shipping is free of duty and VAT (US$200 only for goods from the US)Verified (primary source)Korea Customs Service, list clearance
research/logistics/06-regulations-apac.md §5
Import tax-free limitallSame US$150 limitVerified (primary source)Korea Customs Service
research/logistics/06-regulations-apac.md §5
How limits are testedallPer consignment, including shipping, all-or-nothing: above US$150 the whole value is taxed. Same-supplier same-day shipments may be combined, and we look like one supplierSecondary sourceKCS; braindetox.kr citing KCS 2022-11-16
research/logistics/06-regulations-apac.md §5
q19

research/logistics/06-regulations-apac.md §5
Product safety and chemical rulesallPersonal direct purchases exempt from KC certification; authorities test and block specific productsSecondary sourcesource

Change-of-mind withdrawalall7-day withdrawal (buyer pays postage); refund within 3 business daysSecondary sourcesource
research-product-compliance.md §5
Refund must include duties?allAlmost certainly yes, must includeUnverified or conflictingsource
research-product-compliance.md §5
q19
Legal guarantee for defectsall3 months for defects, at our costSecondary sourcesource
research-product-compliance.md §5

via EU

via EU

TopicCategoryValueStatusSourceQuestionNotes

research/logistics/07-regulations-rest-of-world.md §3
Duty-free limitallNone from 2026-07-01: flat €3 duty per item up to €150 until 2028-07-01, then full duty on all consignments. 'Item' means tariff line, not quantityVerified (primary source)
via EU
TAXUD guidance 2026-06-08; Reg. (EU) 2026/382
research/logistics/07-regulations-rest-of-world.md §3
Import tax-free limitallNone since 2021-07-01; IOSS covers consignments up to €150 intrinsic value (VAT at checkout)Verified (primary source)
via EU
TAXUD
research/logistics/07-regulations-rest-of-world.md §3
How limits are testedallIOSS €150 on intrinsic value excluding shipping; duty on CIF at the EU border; import VAT on customs value + duty + transportVerified (primary source)
via EU
TAXUD
research/logistics/07-regulations-rest-of-world.md §3
Import VAT/GST rateallVAT at the destination Member State's rateVerified (primary source)
via EU
TAXUD
research/logistics/07-regulations-rest-of-world.md §3
Duty rate (indicative)apparel12% MFN on HS 61/62; EVFTA brings most VN lines to about 0% by 2026-27 (fabric must be VN or EU origin)Secondary source
via EU
source
research/logistics/07-regulations-rest-of-world.md §3
Duty rate (indicative)leather_footwear8% (leather uppers) to 16.9-17% MFNSecondary source
via EU
source
research/logistics/07-regulations-rest-of-world.md §3
Other border chargesall€2 Union handling fee from 2026-11-01 (Delegated Reg. 2026/2152); per item vs per category and VAT on the fee unclear; reportedly not refunded on returnsVerified (primary source)
via EU

research/logistics/07-regulations-rest-of-world.md §3
Italy's own €2 national fee postponed to 2027-01-01 (unverified)

via EU
TAXUD
research/logistics/07-regulations-rest-of-world.md §3
Announced or pending changesallCustoms reform in force 2026-09-21: seller becomes 'importer for distance sales', Data Hub reporting; full duty from 2028-07-01; textile EPR in all Member States by 2028-04-17; Forced Labour Regulation from 2027-12-14Verified (primary source)
via EU
TAXUD customs reform

When we must registerallFrom the first sale if we use IOSS (no threshold for non-EU sellers)Secondary source

All-in cost per parcel

List price per parcel for a B2C delivery to a home address, duty-paid where the service can do it: freight at the card's next weight break, fuel (also on the fees it applies to), the fees charged on every parcel (trigger always), and the carrier's duty-paid fee when the border rule says duty or tax is due there. Duties and taxes themselves are left out: they are the same whichever carrier carries the parcel. Fees that depend on the event (remote area, address correction, inspections) and optional ones (insurance, pickup, residential notification at DHL, FedEx third-party billing) are left out. Where a border limit includes shipping (MY, KR, CH), the carrier's freight and fuel stand in for the shipping the buyer pays. Each part is converted to US$ and then summed, display only. VND converted at 26,300 per US$ (research/logistics/02, estimate), other currencies at the ECB reference rates of 2026-11-06, rounded half up to whole dollars.

  • ≥: a part is missing (e.g. fuel or a duty-paid fee not known), so the total is a lower bound.
  • DAP: duty or tax is due at the border and the service does not pay it, so the buyer would pay at the door. Not usable for us as merchant of record.
  • DDP?: duty or tax may be due and the service's duty-paid terms are unknown.
  • Cell colour is the worst status among the parts and the border rule. Weights are actual weights, assumed at or above the volumetric weight.
  • Discount: the share off freight (fuel follows net freight, fees stay) at which the express list price equals the cheapest economy line that is published (verified or secondary), complete and duty-paid on that lane. 'Fees alone exceed it': no freight discount is enough.
